description: This file contains unit tests for environment variable-based configuration functions related to documentation and internationalization providers (docsPiProvider and docsPiModel).

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Tests that the docsPiProvider function returns 'anthropic' when the environment variable envDocsI18nProvider is set to 'anthropic'.

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersOpenAIEnvWhenAvailable
methods.description: Tests that the docsPiProvider function returns 'openai' when envDocsI18nProvider is empty but OPENAI_API_KEY is set.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelUsesProviderDefault
methods.description: Checks that docsPiModel returns the defaultAnthropicModel when envDocsI18nProvider is 'anthropic' and envDocsI18nModel is empty.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelKeepsOpenAIDefaultAtGPT54
methods.description: Verifies that docsPiModel returns defaultOpenAIModel when envDocsI18nProvider is 'openai' and envDocsI18nModel is empty.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Ensures docsPiModel returns the explicit model override 'gpt-5.2' when envDocsI18nModel is set.
